sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
title: 月度销售额
insight: 销售额整体呈上升趋势，年底为旺季峰值；留意异常月份回落原因。

sql: SELECT r.region_name AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY region ORDER BY orders DESC
title: 各地区订单量占比
insight: 订单集中在人口密集区域，西北、西南相对较低，可评估渠道投放。

sql: SELECT product_category AS category, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS sales FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY sales DESC
title: 各品类销售额
insight: 数码、家电贡献销售主体；可结合毛利率评估品类结构。

sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM users WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY city ORDER BY active_users DESC
title: 各城市活跃用户数
insight: 活跃用户集中于人口密集城市，与订单分布基本一致。
